mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 12-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%), the labor market weakness suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (base 2017=100) indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate profits and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) indicates a delayed monetary policy response, which increases the risk of future rate hikes and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market boom (HOUST > 1000), increased homebuilding activity fuels consumer spending and business investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1000.
